tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bsnyen sgrub spyi la gces pa'i yig chung gam+bhī ra bzhugs so//

bsnyen sgrub spyi la gces pa'i man ngag ni/ dpal nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ bsnyen sgrub byed dus dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dang kha 'phro mi bsre/ sdig can gyi gos mi gyon/ khams mi bde ba'i dus ngal gso/ ma mos bzhin nyal sngags mi bgrang*/ bza' ba za zhing sngags mi bzla| bza' btung dang bshang gci dor rjes su kha ma bshal bar sngags mi bzla/ gsal zhing sgra che ba spang*/ zhi ba'i dus drag sngags mi bgrang*/ drag po'i dus zhi ba spang*/ rlung kha drag po dang chu chen gyi 'gram du drag sngags drag tu mi bzla/ ngag nus ma rdzogs par skrangs po dang nad gdon la sngags dang dmigs pa mi byed/ bya spyod la sha chang sgog btsong bud med spang*/ nus pa bskyed phyir smra bcad grangs dang bcas pa 'don/ lo gcig 'bags bsnyen byas pa bas zla gcig smra bcad byas pa dga' 'o gsungs/// / ༈ /yang dam pa'i gsung gis/ yal ba'i gnad lnga ngo ma shes na bsnyen sgrub don med du 'gro/ gnad lnga ni/ lha sgom 'phro bzhag pas lus kyi lha yal/ sngags bzla ba mdo 'dzin rtsar ma sleb par gtam byas pas sngags kyi nus pa yal/ bzlas pa byed dus spro bsdu'i dmigs pa ma byas pas ting nge 'dzin yal/ mtshams ma grol bar ngo gsar dang phrad pas lha'i mtshan ltas yal/ rten gtor dang dam rdzas sogs mis mthong bas rdzas yal lo// gzhan yang bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs rang gi gos dron mo mi la mi ster/ yi dam sgom zhing ting 'dzin gyi skabs dgod pa sogs yeng thabs spang*/ sngags bzla dus me la phu mi gdab| sngags tshad du ma 'khyol bar nad pa dang ser ba mi sngags/ nyams pa dang lto gos mi bsre/ phreng ba byin rlabs tshar nas mi lag mi brgyud/ dme can la 'dzem/ yugs mo'i lto gos spongs/ mdze pho'i nor la 'dzem/ dkon mchog gi dkor la mi 'bag /yang dus tshod lnga ni/ zhi ba snga dro/ rgyas pa dros chen/ dbang nyin phyed/ drag po phyed yol/ bdag gzhan gyi bar gcod sel zhing rbod gtong zlog pa dang gsang ba'i las rnams nam phyed bya'o gsungs so// slob dpon pad+ma'i gsung gis bod kyi sngags pa rnams la rtags dang yon tan tshul bzhin du mi 'byung ba ni mtshams gsum ral ba'i skyon yin/

mtshams gsum ni/ sku mtshams ma grol bar gzhan dang 'phrad pa/ bskang bshags bya/ gsung mtshams ma grol bar ngag shor ba/ yig brgya dang yi ge gsum bzla/ thugs mtshams ma grol bar nyon mongs drag pos bar gcod pa'o/ stong nyid bsgom/ dam tshig gsum nyams na mi 'byung ste/ bskyed pa'i sku mi gsal/ yang yang gsal btab/ bzlas pa'i sngags ma dag sgra zur ma nyams lhag chad med par bya/ bsgoms pa'i ting nge 'dzin g.yel ba'o// dmigs pa rtse gcig tu bsgrim/ bsrung bya gsum nyams na mi 'byung ste/ lus kyi bcud thig le nyams pa/ bdud rtsi dang bcud len bsten/ ngag gi bcud mchil ma dor ba/ āḥnyer gcig gis bsrung bar bya/ yid kyi bcud rnam rtog rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ ting nge 'dzin bsgom/ yan lag ni/ sgrub pa ma thon par gnas mi spo/ spos na sgrub pa yun bsring*/ gdan mi sprug ting 'dzin yun bsring*/ mi dang kha 'phro mi bsre/ bsres na sngags khri tsho gcig de 'phral du bzla/ gtor ma dus ma yol bar 'bul/ yol na bskang bshags bya gtor ma mang po 'bul/ 'thab 'khon mi bya/ bskang bshags dang tshogs brgya rtsa bya/ gtor phud nyams su ma bcug rgyu phud gtsang ma la bya/ sgrub khang du khyi yugs sa mdze pho dme can 'ong mi bcug */song na dug me dang dug khrus bya/ de kun gyi zas skom la 'dzem/ zos na gzungs chus kha bkru/ sma ra dang ag tshom mi breg breg na yig brgya 'don/ rang gi nyal mal du gzhan mi gtang*/ song na dug dung dang dug khrus bya/ phreng bstan mi lag mi 'grem/ 'grems na ru rta dang spos dkar gyi chus bkru/ gzhu mi phab/ bdungs la bzhag /mda' mi bcag /mtshon rtse khar mi bcug /spyir sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ skyon bcu spang dgos te/ bcu las sgra skyon lnga ni/ che ba/ 'byung po lad mo byed cing nyams pa la gsang sgrog 'byung*/

chung ba/ zur mi thon nus pa byin rlabs chung*/ mgyogs pa/ lce dub pas chad pa dang ma dag pa sogs kyi skyon mang*/ bul pa/ grangs mi thems/ me phu pa sngags kyi nus pa g.yel zhing nyams dang lnga'o// bar chad lnga ni/ glo lu ba/ gtam smra ba/ sbrid pa/ gnyid la shor ba/ yengs pa dang lnga'o// 'di lnga ni ting nge 'dzin gyi srog nyams pa'i skyon yin no| |de'ang rngam glog las/ sgra ches skyon ni 'byung po dang*// snod med thos 'gyur bar chad 'byung*// de la sngags kyi nus pa med// bul na bzlas pa'i grangs mi thems// dus 'das bar chad sbyor ba 'byung*// glo dang sbrid pa gtam dang ni// gnyid la sogs pas bar bcad na// de ni yi dwags bdud la sogs// spro nas bar chad sgyur bar byed// sems yengs nus pa mi 'byung ngo// zhes gsungs so// des na bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ bzlas pa'i 'phro la gnyid bro ba/ glal ba/ sbrid pa/ lud pa/ 'og rlung*/ bshang ba/ gci ba sogs byung na de ma thag phreng ba bzhag ste nye reg bya zhing kha bshal nas/ gong gi de 'dra byung skabs kyi sngags de bzlas pa'i grangs su mi gzhug go// de bas na bsnyen sgrub spyi la gnyid sogs bdun po byung skabs kyi sngags de bzlas grangs su mi brtsi ba yin la/ zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi dngos grub sgrub chen gyi skabs ni glal ba sogs ye nas ma byung ba zhig dgos pa yin no| |gzhan yang bsnyen pa'i skabs lha gzhan gyi sngags dang chos spyod byas na yid kyis bshags shing gsol ba btab nas bzlas pa snga ma la 'jug /bgegs srung ba dang*/ nad zhi ba dang*| lhod pa dang*/ bag med pa dang*/ lus sems skyo ba dang*/ ma bsdams pa dang*/ mi gtsang ba dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa sogs 'phral rkyen zhi ba dang*/ mtshams gsum gong du bshad pa ltar ma bsdams par sngags bzlas pa ni rtsa ba'i gzhi bsnyen gyi grangs dang*/ bsnyen pa kha gso ba sogs grangs bsnyen gyi grangs su mi brtsi bar legs grub las gsungs so| |yang bzlas pa'i phyed gnas gcig tu byas phyed gzhan du spos nas bzlas pa dang*/

bzlas pa dus las 'das pa sogs kyis kyang bzlas pa'i go mi chod do// dus las 'das pa zhes pa ni/ bsnyen sgrub kyi thog ma nas thun drug gam/ lnga'am/ bzhi sogs gang bcad pa de nyid bsnyen sgrub ma thon bar sgrig la 'bebs dgos kyi/ rang gi dal khom dang bstun nas thun grangs gang rung byas pas mi 'thus so// gzhan yang srid pa'i gter khyim dang*/ rdzong 'phrang dang*/ rdo rje gtsug lag gi rgyud sogs bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung chen rnams dang bstun zhing*/ bsnyen pa thems kyang rtags med na sngags sdeb kyi gnad la dbab pa sogs mkhas pas gnad dang ldan par bya ba gal che'o/// / ༈ /gzhan yang bsnyen sgrub la mkho ba'i bgrang phreng la'ang rab gnas rgyas par ni gzhan ltar bya la/ 'dir thun 'go so sor bya ba'i byin rlabs ni/ lag gnyis thal mo'i bar du bgrang phreng cha dang phreng thag sogs rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud las gsungs pa lta bu bzung ste/ rang lhar gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas pa a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba as mtshan pa/ lag pa g.yon pa āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba āḥs mtshan pa/ g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams rdo rje dang g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams pad+mar gyur pa'i zla nyi rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyar ba'i bar gyi bgrang phreng gi thag pa dbus ma rdo rje sems dpa'/ phyogs mtshams kyi srad bu brgyad nye ba'i sras brgyad dang*/ phreng rdog rnams rgyal ba lnga rigs dang yum gyis zlas phye ba'i dam pa rigs brgya/ mdo 'dzin chos kyi phung po'i mchod rten/ thog 'jog chos kyi dbyings kyi mchod rten du gyur par bsam/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyis ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par dam tshig pa so so la thim par gyur par bsams te/ oṃ pa de pa de ma hā pa de dzñā na sarba bud+dha ma hā bha we hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.āḥ

zhes pa ci 'grub bzla/ bum chus/ ji ltar bltams pa dang*/ sarba ta thā ga tas dbang bskur/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ 'di ni rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bgrang phreng byin rlabs te rab gnas bsdus pa'ang 'di nyid kyis chog go/// / ༈ /yang bla ma dgongs 'dus nas bshad pa ltar bya ste/ phreng ba lag mthil g.yon du bskyil mdo 'dzin steng du yod par byas la/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mdo 'dzin bsnyen sgrub gang byed de'i gtso bo dang*/ phreng rdog rnams 'khor du bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs bstim/ mchod bstod bya/ lag g.yas me tog thogs nas lha sngags dang*/ rten 'brel snying po dang*/ ā di kā di bzlas la me tog 'thor/ khyad par du/ oṃ ru tsi pra marta na ye rat+na ma ṇi dha ra dzñā na de wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ sngags 'bru rnams 'od zer las mthun gyi kha dog can phreng ba lhar gsal ba la thim/ slar lha rnams kyang phreng ba la thim par bsam/ shis pa brjod/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe thog mar 'bru gsum brgya rtsa bzla/ de nas dbyangs gsal dang*/ rten 'brel snying po/ gong gi phreng ba'i sngags de rnams nyer gcig re bzla/ de nas bzlas pa gang yin la 'jug go /de'ang dang po phreng ba mtshan nyid tshang ba gal che la/ rab gnas byin rlabs tshar nas lus drod dang ma bral bar bcang ba sogs phreng ba'i dam tshig rnams ni bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi phreng ba'i de nyid du bshad pa rnams srung ba gal shin tu che bar snang ngo/// / ༈ /yang rdor dril rtse dgu| rtse lnga gang yin yang rab gnas rgyas pa lha so sor rwa dang pad+ma sogs la bskyed pa logs su shes la/ 'dir bsdus nas cho ga'i sngon du bya ba ni/ rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' zhu ba las byung ba'i thabs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rdo rjer gyur/ dril bu aḥlas rdo rje snyems ma zhu ba las byung ba'i shes rab stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin dril bur gyur/

thal mo ā di kā di yongs su gang ba las lag g.yas g.yon nyi ma dang zla bar gyur par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi hiḥ hi hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang ming med kyis rdo rje snying gar bzung*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hūm̐/ zhes g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang ming med kyis blangs nas dku g.yon par bzung*/ slar rdo rje sngar ltar la dril bu nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du lce bskyod nas dkrol zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā/ nā da swa bhā wa badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥ zhes dkrol/ de nas phrin las gang yin la 'jug go// / ༈ /yang rje dam pa rgya gar gyi man ngag khyad par can kha zas la brten nas sngags kyi nus pa nyams pa gso ba ni/ lce'i sha zos na sngags kyi nus pa gtan nas brlags pas nam du'ang spang bar bya/ lan tshwas zhag bdun nus pa 'phrog /de la ka kha ga gha nga nyer gcig /sgog skyas zhag dgu'am brgyad/ btsong dmar gyis zhag bdun nam lnga/ sgog sngon gyis zhag gsum mam lnga/ ri sgog rnams kyis zhag gcig gi nus pa 'phrog /de rnams la tsa tsha dza dzña nya nyer gcig /la phug gis zhag dgu/ de la ta tha da dha na nyer gcig /zwa tshod kyis zla ba phyed/ de la pa pha ba bha ma nyer gcig /lag len ni/ zas log de rnams zos zin nas kha chus bshal/ rang rang gi sngags nyer gcig re btab nas/ lan tshwa shar/ sgog pa lho/ la phug nub/ zwa tshod byang du dum tsam 'phang*/ lan tshwa ma gtogs gzhan rnams gtun khung du brdungs la 'phang*/ de rnams gang yang zin pa'i rjes su rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar yud tsam bsgom/ de'i rting kha chus bshal/ de nas sgom bzlas la zhugs pas zas log gi nyes pa mi 'byung zhes gsungs pa'ang gnad ches zab bo// 'di la 'dra min 'ga' zhig 'byung yang 'di nyid zab par mchis so/// /

༈ /yang dam pa'i gsung ltar bzlas brjod dang bskyed rdzogs dge sbyor gyi thog mar/ oṃ na mo sam+bha ra sam+bha ra bi ma na sa ra ma hā dza ba hūm̐/ zhes bdun brjod pas bzlas sgom gang byas 'gyur che bar gsungs/ yang bzlas pa'i thog mar/ lag pa g.yas nyi mar kā di dmar po/ g.yon zla bar ā di dkar po bsams pa'i bar du bgrang phreng bskyil nas thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra warta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bdun yan chad bzlas nas phreng ba la phus btab na bzlas brjod gang byas grangs med par 'gyur bar gsungs so// oṃ sma ra sma ra bi ma na sa ra ma hā dza ba hūm̐/ zhes pa chos spyod kun gyi sngon du bzlas na bye ba 'gyur bar rgyal bas gsungs/ zhes bka' gdams glegs bam las jo bos gsungs/// / ༈ /yang slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i man ngag lta ba'i rdzong 'phrang las/ spyir gdams ngag la chos mi 'grub pa'i rgyu dgu yod/ sgom sgrub g.yel ba'i rgyu dgu/ bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub las la 'bras bu med pa'i rgyu dgu/ srung mas 'khu ldog byed pa'i rgyu dgu/ drag byed bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub pa'i rgyu dgu/ bsod nams 'dzad pa'i rgyu dgu/ dngos grub yal ba'i rgyu dgu/ nus pa mi skye ba'i rgyu dgu/ byin rlabs med pa'i rgyu dgu rnams yod do// dang po chos mi 'grub pa'i rgyu dgu ni/ dad pa chung ba/ che dgos/ shes rab chung ba/ che dgos/ brtson 'grus chung ba che dgos dang gsum/ dpe cha 'bri mi nus pa/ nus dgos/ lha mchod mi nus pa nus dgos/ rgyu'i zhabs tog mi nus pa nus dgos dang gsum/ rnam rtog mi thub pa/ thub dgos/ lto mi thub pa| thub dgos/ 'dod chags mi thub pa thub dgos dang dgu'o// gnyis pa sgom sgrub g.yel ba'i rgyu dgu ni/ me dang nyi ma gnyid dang gsum/ kha 'chal dal gtam rtsed mo gsum/ mi bya/

mgo sngas la phab pa dang*/ rgyab rten mgo gtum mi brten mi bya'o/ gsum 'di rnams ma byas na mi g.yel lo dang dgu'o// gsum pa bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub/ las la 'bras bu med pa'i rgyu dgu ni/ zas ngan mdze yugs dam nyams sogs kyi tsag tsog za ba dang*// gos ngan nyes gos gdon grib dme po sogs skye gos gyon pa dang*// gtsang sbra bya ba mi byed pa dang gsum/ mtshams lhod pa dang*/ ba liṃ ngan pa dang*/ 'phral gyi las kyi brtson 'grus chung ba dang gsum/ lus lha ru byin gyis mi rlob pa dang*/ ngag bzlas brjod rgyun bcad pa dang*/ sems ting nge 'dzin zhan zhing 'od zer spro bsdu bcad pa dang dgu'o// bzhi pa srung mas 'khu ldog byed pa'i rgyu dgu ni/ bud med rang gi chung ma sogs sgrub khang nang du jo 'dzing byung ba dang*/ skye bo rang gi 'khor g.yog sogs gri 'dzing byung ba dang*/ dpa' gnyis kha 'thab byung ba dang*/ ba liṃ ngan pa'i steng du phrin las drag po byas pa dang*/ dus kyi ba liṃ chag pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bskang zhing bshags pa la mi 'bad pa dag kyang ngo// dang*| glo bur du bsgral ba'i las byas pa dang*/ rang la rma med par rma byung ba dang*/ bar skabs su dgra nor blangs pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams chag ma bskang ba dang dgu'o// lnga pa drag byed bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub par rgud pa'i rgyu dgu ni/ sgrub khang du bud med chags btsog 'ong ba dang*/ dme can tsag tsog 'ong ba dang*/ skye bo sdig can 'ong ba dang*/ snod stong can dang*/ bcad nag can dang*/ ngo grang can 'ong ba dang*/ skar khung nas nang du blta sa yod pa dang*/ thog steng du mi gtsang ba btsog 'dre can 'grims pa dang*/ bud med yugs sa bye bral nal ma sogs mi gtsang ba dang dgu'o// drug pa bsod nams 'dzad pa'i rgyu dgu ni/ rdo rje slob dpon mi bkur ba dang*/ yi dam gyi 'dzab bsnyen chag pa dang*/

srung ma'i ba liṃ chag pa dang*/ dkon mchog la mchod pa chag pa dang*/ mched grogs rnams la mi gdung ba dang*/ phyi'i 'byung po la gtor ma mi sbyin zhing chos skyong spyi la ba liṃ mi gtong ba dang*/ chos la yid mi ches shing phyi'i rim gro mi byed pa dang*/ nang gi mtshan ma mi brtag par mo rtsis byed pa dang*/ skye ba'i mtha' rgya skyong zhing lha chos kyi mtha' rgya mi bsrung ba dang dgu'o| |bdun pa dngos grub yal ba'i rgyu dgu ni/ sgrub pa ci byed kyang de'i dus su lha'i ming dang sngags dang grub pa'i rtags gzhan la bshad pa dang*/ gzhan la dbang bskur byin rlabs byed pa dang*/ gzhan gyi rim gro byed pa dang*/ ser ba srung ba dang*/ gzhan la lha'i snying po sogs bzla bya'i sngags 'debs pa dang*/ gdams ngag zab pa gzhan la bshad pa dang dgu'o| |brgyad pa nus pa nyams pa'i rgyu dgu ni/ lus bskyed rim nyams pa/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems nyams pa/ chos sku byang chub kyi sgom nyams pa/ yan lag bdun pa chag pa| sngags bzlas brjod rgyun bcad pa/ drag po'i phrin las kyi rgyun bcad pa/ snang ba dbang du bsdu ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bcad pa/ don med du phrin las bskul zhing las la sbyor ba/ sdig can gyi dgra bo sgrol ba'i ting nge 'dzin g.yel ba dang dgu'o// dgu pa byin rlabs med pa'i rgyu dgu ni/ gu ru la shags byed pa/ zhabs tog mi byed pa/ mi bkur ba/ bstod pa mi byed pa/ phyag mi 'tshal ba/ lha srung khyad du gsod cing shags byed pa/ yon tan mi brjod pa/ rgyun du mi gdung zhing mi brtsi ba/ khro ba dang dgu'o// de ltar dgu dgu dgu phrugs 'di rnams ni sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa rnams la med ka med yin no/// / ༈ /yang mdo sde bye ba las/ dge sbyor bsnyen sgrub gang byed kyi 'gor/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra ma hā dza ba hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan bdun dang*/ mthar/ oṃ ru ru dha ru mu khe mu khe ye swā hā/

zhes bdun bzlas na dge sbyor sogs gang byas bye ba 'bum 'gyur du gsungs so/ tad+ya thā/ pañtsan+d+ri ya a wa bo dha ni swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ ha nu bha sha bha ra hṛ da ya swā hā/ zhes pa 'di nyid chos spyod gang byas kyi mthar/ lan bdun bdun brjod na grangs med par 'gyur bar gsungs so/// / ༈ /yang yongs bsngo 'khor lo'i mdo nas/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra warta na ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bdun bzlas phreng bar btab ste bzlas na bye bar 'gyur du gsungs so// *// ༈ /yang pad+ma 'byung ba'i rgyud nas/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma narte shwa ra hūm̐/ 'di brgya'am nyer gcig brjod nas bzlas pa gang byed dung 'gyur du gsungs so// yang gter ston dri med rdo rje'i zab gter za yig nor bu'i bang mdzod las/ a.a.ak+saṭa ma rgyal dang ldan pa'i dus// gi waṃ kha che'i chu yis byug /nangs rer mos ldan bu yis bsten// sngags kyi nus pa dung phyur 'gyur/ za yig 'di zos nas sngags bzla ba'i tshe ya so rnams dpa' bo dang ma so rnams dpa' mor bsam/ sngags bzlas pa tsam gyis de rnams skus gar mdzad/ gsung gis sngags bzlas pas phrin las gang yin thogs med du 'grub par bsams la bzlas pas nges par dung phyur sogs su 'gyur ro zhes yig chung dang bcas zab pa'i mthar thug go/ /yi dam lha yis byin gyis rlob// nyams grib bar chad kun dang bral// mtsho rgyal tsit+ta'i dkyil du spos// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: : zhes pa gter ston dri med rdo rje'i zab gter za yig nor bu'i bang mdzod nas phyung ba'o/// / ༈ /yang 'gyur khyad che ba'i dus bzang ni/ rgya rtsis gsar ma phug lugs kyi hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bdun la sangs rgyas bltams pa dang*/ bco lnga la sangs rgyas pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa ste gsum/ drug pa'i tshes bzhi la chos 'khor bskor ba dang*/ bco lnga la lhums su zhugs pa gnyis/ dgu pa'i nyer gnyis lha bab/

dang po'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar cho 'phrul chen po'i dus chen no/// / ༈ /yang rgya rtsis rnying ma bla ma dgongs 'dus las/ cho 'phrul chen po ni rgya rtsis gsar ma dang 'dra la/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga la mngon par sangs rgyas pa dang*/ tshes brgyad la bltams pa dang*/ zla ba 'di'i bco lnga la lhums su zhugs pas dus chen gsum/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ bdun pa'i bco lnga la lha las bab/ 'ga' zhig gis nyi shu la'ang 'dod/ zla ba 'di la cho 'phrul chung ngur yang grags so// de lta bu'i dus chen rnams la dge sgrub byas pa'i 'gyur khyad ni/ ji skad du/ de ltar dus chen rnam bzhi la/ lhag bsam jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas lhag pa'i bsam pa ni g.yo dang rgyu med pa'i bsam pa la zer ba yin gsung ngo// dag pas nas phul gang*// sbyin par btang na nas phul ni// sa ya phrag brgyar 'gyur ba'i phyir// nas khal brgyad 'bum sum khri dang*// sum stong sum brgya sum cu gnyis// bre drug phul bzhi'i 'gyur khyad ni// 'byung bar rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs// zhes so| |gzhan yang*/ ji skad du/ nyi ma zla ba gzas zin dang*// ya mtshan che ltas byung ba dang*// cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la// bsgrims te dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes sogs gsungs so// gzhan yang gza' 'dzin la/ nyi 'dzin la nyi ma'i mdo las bye ba 'bum 'gyur dang*/ zla 'dzin la zla ba'i mdo las bye ba bdun 'gyur du gsungs la/ dus chen rnams su gza' 'dzin byung na 'gyur khyad snga ma'i steng du gza' 'dzin gyi 'gyur khyad rnams 'byung ba yin no/// / ༈ /yang rgyal ba yang dgon pas sngags bzla ba'i snga rol tu/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra warta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa bdun dang*/ rten 'brel snying po lan gsum gyis phreng ba byin gyis brlabs nas bzlas pa la 'jug /phreng ba sa rjen la reg tu mi gzhug

/mi lag mi brgyud/ gsang ba'i phreng ba mi la mi ston pa yin/ phreng thag dgu sgril/ mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs bya'o// phreng ba gcig la mi 'dra ba mang po brgyus na rten 'brel la mi shong*/ phreng ba la mgron bu btags na rgyags la gzan/ bzlas pa ci tsam byed pa'i ring mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bya/ khyad par bsnyen pa'i dus mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bya/ mi tshig gis bar chod na de bzlas pa'i grangs su mi the/ bdud rtsi'i ril bu lce thog tu bzhag /mchil ma phyir mi dor/ mtshon rtse khar mi gzhug /gzhan la byin rlabs byed pa dang ser ba srung ba sogs lhag pa'i lha'i rtsa sngags kyis mi byed pa yin/ yi dam gtso bo 'di la byed pa gsang dgos pa yin/ sngags bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ oṃ a āḥha k+ṣa hā swā hā grub par gyur cig |ces lan gsum bzlas pas sngags myur du 'grub pa dang chad lhag gi kha skong ba yin no// yi dam mang po yod na lha gcig tu bsdu ba'i man ngag ni/ thog mar rang gi rtsa ba'i yi dam de'i mngon rtogs bsgom/ bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas yi dam gzhan de spyan drangs rang la bstim/ de'i bzlas pa bya/ de lta bu yi dam du yod la bya/ tshar ba dang bum pa gcig nas nor bu du ma 'don pa bzhin lha thams cad rang gi zhal lam thugs ka nas rim gyis bton la mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod gtor 'bul/ bstod nas gshegs su gsol/ rang rtsa ba'i yi dam gyi ngang nas spyod lam bya'o// 'di ni lha thams cad gcig tu bsdu ba'i man ngag yi dam thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang sngags thams cad nus pa gcig tu 'du/ dngos grub myur du 'thob pa'i gdams pa'o// ji skad du/ bde gshegs gcig sgom rgyal ba kun gyi ngang*// zhes pa'i don no// 'di ḍoṃ bhi pa'i man ngag go zhes rgyal ba yang dgon pas gsungs so/// / ༈ /paṇa chen shākya shrīs/ dus mchod chen po bzhi la ni// bye ba phrag brgya'i 'gyur du gsungs// zhes so// *//

༈ /rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ ru rak+sha yis bye ba gnyis// pad+mas bye ba brgyad du 'gyur// pu tro dzi ba bod skad la bu'i 'tsho ba zer skad dod 'di zur chag pa deng sang bo dhi tsir grags zhes skyo ston gyis gsungs/ grangs med do| |zhes so/// / ༈ /nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi gzungs las/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra warta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di bgrang phreng la lan bdun btab nas bzlas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po bye ba phrag brgya stong snyed bzlas par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so/// / ༈ /srid pa'i gter khyim las/ sgrub pa gang byed kyang gzhan gyi phye phud bsrung*| 'bag btsog rnams bsrung*/ dme yugs mi gtsang ba rnams bsrung*/ gzhan dang kha mi bsre/ nang 'khon mi bya/ rang gi gos mi la mi bkon/ rang gi lus dang phor sder mi bkru| yugs sa mo dang mi nyal/ skra dang sen mo mi breg /gdan mi sprug /khyi phag mi gtang*/ khyi la zan za 'phro mi ster/ smra bcad dam du bya/ mtshams g.yog bud med la mi 'chol/ grib la 'dzem par gces so// rtsa ba'i bla ma ma gtogs pa gzhan la phyag mi 'tshal/ rang gi grib ma la 'gong du mi bcug /dam tshig 'di rnams bsrung na mthu dang nus pa ldan par 'byung ngo*| |zhes gsungs 'dug go// / ༈ /yang bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i o rgyan gyi zhal gdams dmar khrid don bsdus thugs kyi phreng bar/ de'ang sgrub pa ma thon gyi bar du gzhan gyi gos mi gyon/ grib 'jug sgrub pa g.yel la 'chor ba yin/ zas bzang thal na nyon mongs pa'i dbang du 'gro/ ngan na lus stobs nyams nas dka' thub mi nus pas bzang ngan snyoms shing tshod zin par bya: dam nyams/ yugs sa/ dme po/ rkun ma/ sdom shor la sogs pa'i nyams grib can dang : gdon chen gyi lag nas byung ba'i zas mi za: de zos na sgrub pa kha 'gyang*| mthar mi phyin par bar chad 'byung ba yin:

mal gyi stan mi spo: sgrub pa dang dam bca'i tshad ma thems par stan spos sam/ mal spos na drod rtags g.yel ba dang*/ glo bur ye 'drog 'byung : gzhan gyi srung skyob byas na nus pa nyams pas gzhan gyi srung skyob dang 'dre rdung mi bya: gos dreg pa can dang lus mi bkru: dngos grub yal nas 'gro ba yin: skra sen dang kha spu breg na sngags kyi ngar nyams pa yin pas mi breg: mtshams khungs nas chos mi 'chad: grub rtags mi thon pa yin: dam bca'i khas len yun ring po byed ces dus gcig la mi bya/ bdud 'jug pa yin pas bsring zhing bya: gzhan dang ngag 'dres na sngags gros su mi 'dod pas smra ba bcad/ gsang sngags rdo rje khro bo'i bzlas pa rnams skad gsang mthon por bklags na nus pa nyams shing mi ma yin pa pa 'phra'u skrag nas dngangs shing brgyal bar 'gyur bas shab shub tu dag par bzla/ gan rkyal du nyal nas phreng ba brang gi steng du 'dren zhing bzlas pa byas na rang gis rang mnan pa yin: lar lus drang por gnas na rtsa drang por gnas: rlung drang por 'gyu: lus rig gnyis zung 'brel yin pas rlung drang por 'gyu na: rig pa gang la gtad pa'i dmigs pa dang ting nge 'dzin las su rung ba'i dgos pa yod: lus gnad bsam gtan gyi chos bdun la sogs pa shin tu gal che la/ phu mi gdab: mchil snabs bsad zlog gi dus ma gtogs phyir mi dor: sngags la sel 'jug: ngag gnon du 'gyur bas mchil snabs 'grim lam sar mi dor: nyin par gnyid mi nyal/ 'di la skyon gyi rnam grangs shin tu mang bas ci nas kyang rnam pa thams cad du spang: sgrub pa ma thon gyi bar du bya byed rnam g.yeng lus ngag yid gsum rab tu 'khrugs shing gzing ba'i las mi bya bar gang yin pa'i sgrub pa de nyid la 'bad de mthar dbyung: grub rtags bzang ngan cho 'phrul gyi rnam pa ci byung yang dga' ba dang mi dga' ba'i blang dor gyi brtag dpyad gang yang mi byed par rnal 'byor pa'i blo rang mal du phab la sgrub pa nar gyis bsring:

dka' thub dang sgrub pa thon nas gtang rag gi mchod pa yang rim pas gtang ngo: mtshams glod nas kyang zhag 'ga'i bar du mtshams rjes srung zhing grong yul sogs su mi 'khyam/ rang gi mal du zhag gsum gyi bar du mi gzhan mi nyal: sgrub rjes dam tshig mi gcig pa'i mis mi mthong bar bya: sgrub rdzas gzhan la mi ston: dngos grub kyi rdzas mi la mi sbyin: rang gis longs spyad: sgrub pa'i dbu btsugs nas mjug ma thon gyi bar ci byung yang mtshams hur 'don mi bya: bar chad kyi bdud yin pas ngos bzung la rkyen khar mi gtang : lar bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas spyod lam gang byung mi bya: zas ci rnyed rnyed mi za: gos dreg pa can dang skyi bem la sogs grib can mi gyon: gar thod thod du mi nyal: zag pa mis mthong ba dang*/ 'grim lam du mi 'dor/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dus ma yin par mi bya ba la sogs pa ste: rnam pa thams cad du spyod lam la shin tu zhib pa gtso che/ spyir bde bar 'dod na/ dang po dka' thub la sogs pa brtul zhugs kyis thog drangs nas nyi nub thun gyi cha bgos te: nyams len srang la gcur na bde: yun ring bar yong ba yin pas sems la zhog /ces dang*/ de nyid las/ gdams pa ma nyams pa de rgyud la len tsa na rgyun du ngag gi mtshams smra ba gcod pa gal che: g.yeng ba rnams kyi nang nas che ba de smra ba mang ba yin pas: long gtam dab dib dge sbyor gyi sad yin: smra bcad byas na mtshams kyi nang nas mchog dam pa ste: lus tshong 'dus na 'dug kyang mi lto'o: dka' thub ji tsam byed kyang smra bcad nus na shin tu legs: de tsam ma grub kyang dge sbyor gang dang gang gi thun tshad ma thems kyi bar du smra bcad ci nas kyang byed dgos| gang byed pa'i dge sbyor la smra ba bcad de/ gzhan tshig gis bar ma chod par byas na: ngag la nus pa 'byung zhing myur du 'grub pa yin: lar chos kyi bya ba ma yin pa'i smra ba mang ba la dgos pa med cing :

smra ba bcad nas bzlas brjod la sogs pa ngag gi sgo nas byang chub sgrub pa'i bya ba ma byas na/ lkugs pa dang 'dra bas sems la zhog /ces gsungs: yang de nyid nas/ bzlas pa'i grangs kyi thun tshad bzung ba 'di'ang gal che ste/ de'ang bzlas pa byed pa'i thun gsum mam bzhi/ zhag re la thun byas la bzlas rkang ring thung gi tshod dang bstun nas nyin khri mtshan khri: nyin stong mtshan stong: nyin brgya mtshan brgya la sogs pa ste/ mthar thug kyang nyin brgya mtshan brgya re dam bca' byas te/ de ma grub kyi bar du ngag bcad la: mi tshig gis bar ma chod par byas pas bar gcod mi 'byung : bskyed rdzogs zung du 'brel zhing bsnyen sgrub chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du 'bad pa 'di gdams pa nyams len phyin ci ma log pa'i khyad chos yin: sgrib pa sbyong ba dang : tshogs gsog pa dang : bar chad sel bar 'dod pa dang : dngos grub rnam gnyis myur du sgrub par 'dod pa la sogs pa'i yid smon thams cad kyang bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel bsnyen sgrub kyis bde blag tu 'grub pa yin: bsnyen sgrub thams cad kyi nang nas kyang bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po 'bru gsum po 'di la ma 'dus pa med pas 'di la g.yar dam du bya ba'am: bzla ba'i sngags thams cad kyi dbu la btags pas byin rlabs shin tu che'o: lar thigs pa bsags pas rgya mtshor 'gyur ba yin: mchu mi sdod par sngags 'bru re re tsam nas kyang rgyun du gsog pa gal che zhing : dus tshod gcig na 'grub rgyu gcig 'byung bas sems la zhog /ces gsungs/// / ༈ /yang 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bcu gnyis par/ dang po ruk+sha dag yin te: in+d+rak+ṣa ni 'bring gnyis pa yin/ tha ma bo dhi tsi yin la// gzhan yang 'bras bu yod pa'i shing las dang rjes su mthun pa pa'o// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ na maḥsarba bud+dhā nāṃ/ a tsin+t+yarbud+dha rū pi ṇaṃ/

tad+ya thā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru sarba ar+thān+ta sā dha ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭa bi mo ha ni/ ga ga na pa lam+be/ bi sho dha ye swā hā/ sngags 'dis phreng ba thams cad las bya'o// spyad pa dang dgug pa dang blang ba dang rgyu ba la sogs pa'i las bya'o// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ chu bo dag ni dri med pa'i// chu gtsang dag gis khrus bya zhing*// phreng ba rjes su blangs nas ni// ba yi rnam lngas rab tu bkru// dri zhim dag gis rjes byugs nas// rab tu sngags la 'bad pa yis| |nye reg byas nas bzlas par 'jug /ces thog ma nyid nas chu gtsang gis rang gi kha lag bkrus nas: de rjes phreng ba ba'i rnam lngas bkrus/ dri bzang byugs la gong gi phreng ba lhag gnas kyi sngags brgya'am nyer gcig sogs bzlas la phreng ba la btab/ de'i rjes rang nye reg byas nas bzlas pa gang byed la 'jug par gsungs so: yang de nyid las/ ru rak+sha dang bo dhi tsi| |in+d+rak+ṣa yi 'bras bu nyid// rtag tu lung thang mdzes pa dang*// gzhan yang 'bras bu yod pa dag /'bad pa yis ni phreng ba bya// zhes so// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin pa dag gis ni phreng ba lhag gnas 'di nyid skabs su bab par mngon no/// / ༈ /yang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi skabs smra bcad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ zla gsang rtsa rgyud kyi yang gsang drag po'i le'u bcu gsum pa las/ rnal 'byor nang la gtam zer na// lag gi brda yis brda bar bya// skom dang za bar 'dod pa'i tshe: lag gi brda yis blang bar bya// smras na rnal 'byor rang don zad// de yi phyir na lag brda bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// nā ro pas mdzad pa'i sngags kyi mig go// / ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ yo ga man+t+ro pa de sha/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor pas sngags bzla ba'i man ngag /rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis// sngags kyi nus pa skye 'dod pas// sngags kyi spyod lam 'di bya ste// rnal 'byor sngags pas sngags bgrang tshe// dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dag dang*// nam yang kha 'phro mi bsre zhing*// sdig pa can gyi gos mi gyon// khams mi bde ba'i skabs su ni// ngal gso khams bsang chos nyid bsgom// dad pa med dang le lo spang*// ma mos nyal sngags bzla ba spang*// bza' ba za zhing sngags zlos spang*// btung ba 'thung zhing sngags zlos spang*// kha ma bshal bar sngags zlos spang*// bsam pa med par sngags zlos spang*// lha ma gsal bar sngags zlos spang*// gnyid kyi dbang du gyur pa spang*// gsal zhing sngags sgra che ba spang*// zhi ba'i dus su drag po spang*// drag po'i dus su zhi ba spang*// dbang gi dus su zhi ba spang*// sngags bzlas gzhan du spel ba spang*// sgrub sngags 'jam zhing bzla ba spang*// rlung kha chen po chu chen 'gram// drag sngags zab mo mi bzla'o// sngags kyi yig 'bru 'khyar ba spang*// dgra gdon nad la sogs pa la/

/nus pa yongs rdzogs dmigs pa spang*| |snod min dag la spel mi bya// gsang sngags grong yul dag tu spang*// kṛ ya la sogs sngags rnams dang*// 'bras bu dman pa'i sngags la sogs// pha ma gnyis med ma gtogs rgyud// gzhan la sha chang bud med dang*// sgog pa sogs spang gtsang sbra bya// 'phral gyi nus pa 'dod pa la// smra bcad grangs dang bcas pa 'don// bla med dngos grub 'dod pa la| |gzhung bzhin rtags rdzogs bar du 'don// phyag rgya chen po 'dod pa la// de nyid gsum gsal yun du 'don// nus pa myur du skye 'dod na// smra ba bcad bzlas dngos grub 'phel// lo gcig rang gar bzlas pa bas// zla gcig smra bcad nus pa che// yul du lo gcig bsgrubs pa bas// dben pa zhag gcig bsten pa legs// sgrub po sngags kyi rnal 'byor par| |gdams ngag nyer gcig 'di ldan na// tshe 'dir mchog dang thun mong 'grub// sngags bzla ba'i man ngag slob dpon chen po nā ro pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis byang puṣ+pa ha ri'i dgon par bsgyur cing zhus te sgom sgrub kyis gtan la phab pa'o/// / ༈ /gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ nus pa mi 'dzad par byed na gang bsgrubs kyi sngags gsham du rten 'brel snying po btags nas bdun phrag gcig sgrub bo// yang gzhan la dbang bskur mang po byas pa'am/ srung ba byas sam/ zlog pa byas sam| 'dre rdung byas pa sogs kyis nus pa nyams 'gro bas de gso na/ yi dam lha'i bsnyen pa sor btsud la/ bum chur rten 'brel snying po'i gzungs sgrub byas la khrus bya'o// yang dus min 'chi ba zlog pa dang*/ sngags kyi nus pa mi yal zhing byin rlabs che bar byed na/ sgom sgrub thams cad kyi thog mar ā di kā di tshar gsum bzlas rjes sgom sgrub la 'jug /thun mthar rten 'brel snying po gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun bzlas na/

nus pa brtan pa'i rab gnas su 'gro ba yin no// yang grangs ni/ brgya rtsa dgos na gcig ma tshang ba'am/ stong rtsa la brgya ma tshang ba'am/ khri khrag la stong ma tshang ba sogs ni rgyun chad pa zhes shin tu ngan pas grangs las lhag gam ma chad pa shis so/// / ༈ /yang sngags rnams bzla ba'i tshe/ nyal nas ma yin langs nas min// rgod cing ma yin 'chag cing min// bza' btung dang ni bsres pa dang*// 'bags chag ma blang bzla ba min// gos gdan sprug sogs bya ba min// zhes so/// / ༈ /yang thun so so'i mthar/ bdag gis thun 'di la bsnyen grangs brgya stong sogs che ge mo bton pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di/ lhag pa'i lha mchog che ge mo khyed la 'bul bar bgyi'o// de phul ba'i mthu la brten nas sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog med nas da lta'i bar gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag pa dang*/ mchog rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thun mong phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa chen pos bden pa 'di 'grub par gyur cig /ces dang*/ rten 'brel snying po ci mang bzla'o/// / ༈ /yang sngags phreng rdog gi grangs su brtsi ba'i skabs/ mi dang gtam shor na phreng rdog bzhi/ glo lu na lnga/ glal na gsum/ sbrid pa byung na bcu/ mchil ma dor na gcig rnam grangs su mi brtsi bar slar ldog go// / ༈ /yang*/ rten gtor khyi la shor ba dang*/ mal stan nam mkha'i mthongs su sprug /rwa dang rus thod phreng ma gtogs pa'i phreng bar bgrang*// 'di ni lha sgrub zhud pas spongs// zhes kyang 'byung ngo/// / ༈ /yang rdo rje dpon slob ni// dus chen bzhi po gang rung dus// dge ba 'bum du rgyal bas gsungs// sher snying tshar gcig bton pa na// 'bum tshar nyi shu bton par 'gyur// tshul khrims ldan pa'i dge slong ni// gcig la gdan gnon bshos drangs na| |dge slong sa ya brgya phrag la// 'tsho ba phul ba'i bsod nams 'thob// ces gsungs/

paṇa chen shākya shrīs/ dus chen bzhi dang tha mal pa'i// khyad par sil bu myang 'das las| |sa ya phrag brgya'i 'gyur du gsungs// nyi ma gza' yis zin pa'i dus// bye ba phrag ni 'bum 'gyur te// zla bar bye ba bdun 'gyur ro// dus chen bzhi por nyi zla bzung*// de dag bsod nams khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs/ chag lo tsā bas/ dus chen bzhi la nas rdog gcig sbyin par btang na/ nas rdog sa ya phrag brgyar 'gyur/ de nas khal du bsdoms na/ khal bdun brgya dang bre bcu bdun phul bzhi khyor ba bzhi 'ong*/ zhes gsungs/ yang mkhas grub chos rje dge legs dpal bzang pos/ lha gang yin yang tshig mgo mjug tshang ba grub rjes/ bgrang phreng la thun rang rang gi lugs kyi gsung rdo rjer bskyed la ye shes pa bzhugs nas bzlas pa'i mthar thug pa byas rjes lha yongs su gyur pa bgrang phreng gi rnam pa'am/ gshin rje sogs la khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bor bltas la/ rang rang gi spro bsdu'i dmigs pa ji ltar bshad pa ltar gsal bzhin pas smra bcad byas pa'i bzlas pa ji tsam grub pa rnams bsnyen pa'i grangs su rtsi bas grangs 'dzin la bgrang la/ thun mtshams dang*/ bza' btung dang*/ gtam gleng ba sogs dang*/ 'gro ba'i tshe bzlas pa'i sngags rnams bsnyen pa'i grangs su mi bgrang la/ 'on kyang bar chad srung ba dang*/ ngag nus pa skyed pa dang*/ lha'i thugs rgyud bskul ba dang*/ chad lhag kha 'gengs pa sogs kyi slad du bshang gci 'dor ba'i skabs tshun chad du sngags bzla ba gal che la| de rnams bsnyen grangs su ni mi brtsi gsungs pa legs la/ pha bla ma 'dis yi dam bde mchog lta bu bsgoms nas sngags dgyes rdor lta bu bzla ba ni ches shin tu mi 'thad la des thams cad la 'gre bar gsungs 'dug cing de sogs 'ga' zhig gsungs 'dug go// / ༈ /yang slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i man ngag gser phreng du/ bsnyen pa nye snying drod tshad thob// tshad du ma phyin skyor ba yin// tshad las 'phags pa yon tan yin// bsnyen pa bsnyen pa'i grangs ni bre bcu la zer sa ya gcig yin dus bdun phrag gsum yin rtags rab dngos 'bring nyams tha ma rmi lam du gsungs 'dug go//

rdzogs nas sgrub pa brtsam// grangs ni khri yin dus zhag gcig /mtshan ma gsum ston stobs ldan pa// sgrub pa'i drod tshad yin par bshad// phrin las zhi rgyas dbang dang drag /bsad gsod smra bcad la sogs pa// gang byed sgrub pa chen po yin// zhi bas tshe ring nad med 'gyur// rgyas par sbyar bas phun sum tshogs// dbang gis khams gsum dbang du sdud// drag pos dgra bgegs 'dul bar byed// mtshan ma bla rtags dbang med dang*// 'gugs gcod gsod pa srog gi rtags// 'byung ba g.yo dang thog ser dang*// cho 'phrul ltas ngan la sogs pa// mngon sum nyams dang rmi lam snang*// 'di nyid rtags su shes par bya// zhi ba dag la grangs mang yang*// zug rngu med cing gnod mi 'gyur// rgyas pa'i las la grangs med cing*// gnod dang nyes pa med pa yin// dbang du sdud dang drag po'i sngags// tshad las 'das na sngags pa dag /tshe thung nad mang dgra bgegs 'byung*// bsad sngags tshad las 'das pa na// sngags pa dus min 'chi bar 'gyur// thog ser dbab pa'i sngags la ni// tshad las 'das na yul khams phung*// gzir mnan sngags ni tshad 'das na// sngags bdag nus pa bcom pa'i phyir// dam tshig nyams te las mi 'grub// ltas ngan dbab sngags tshad 'das na// ltas ngan bdag gi 'khor la 'ong*// de phyir drod tshad brtag par gces// rang dang gsang sba mang gsang gter// grangs dus mtshan ma gong ma bzhin// des kyang gal te ma grub na// spog chog spog pa'i las rnams kun// rim pa bzhin du mkhas pas bya// des kyang ma grub gnad la dbab// zlog cing gnad dbab dkrug cing bsad// gzir mnan la sogs ci rigs bya// de nas bdag nyid dam ldan pa// tha mal mi sdod yi dam gyi// rgyud kyi ting 'dzin gsal bya zhing*// snang stong dbyer med bsgom par bya// 'das dang ma 'das srung ma la// mchod dang bskang dang bstod pa dang*// bsnyen sgrub las rim gtsor byed pa'i// sngags pas rgyun du 'di ltar bya// sngon du yi dam rgyud bzhin bsgrubs// rjes la las mkhan bsgrub par bya// srog snying tshad dang ldan par bzlas// phrin las gang byed las mkhan bskul// rang nyid yi dam rgyun du bsgom/ */rtag tu de skor bsgrub pa la/ */mthu dang byin rlabs dpag tu med/ */sngags dang sgom pa'i dngos grub thob// phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gter// gsang chen gyi ni sgrub pa'o// zhes gsungs 'dug pa rnams sngags pa la shin tu gal che bar snang bas khol bur bris pa yin no// 'di rnams ni 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i sngags ban rgan po chos kyi grags pa zhes 'bod pa rim pa gnyis la gtso bor 'dzin pa/ deng sang gi ban sngags rnams ltar grong chog dang zol zog la mi blta ba/ ngos bka' brgyud kyi bstan bcos rnams bltas pas nyer mkhor 'dug pa rnams khol bu zin thun du bsags nas bris pa yin no/// /sarba maṅga laṃ//
